name: Every Lua file under src/ parses
step: Compile every tracked src/**/*.lua without running it
rationale:
Most harnesses load only the modules they test, so a file that no harness loads is never parsed in CI, and a
broken line in it only fails on the radio when its page opens. PR #2722 had one: a module held a literal "\r\n" as text,
did not parse, and every check was green.

The harness compiles every file `git ls-files` lists under src/ with load() in text mode, without running it, and
names each file that does not parse. Before the scan it checks itself: a chunk with the same kind of broken line must be
refused and a well-formed one accepted, on every run, so CI proves the job can go red.
